summary: Regression-tested the Expo web preview at https://implant-lookup-addon.preview.emergentagent.com (frontend-only, per request). (1) Login screen renders cleanly: 'Ortho Logbook' title, email/password inputs (login-email-input, login-password-input), Log In button (login-submit-button), Forgot password and Join clinic links — no red screen, ZERO page errors. (2) /patient-form renders 'New Patient' with ALL required fields and exact testIDs/placeholders: patient-procedure-input ('Type to search procedures'), patient-implant-input ('Type to search implants'), patient-implant2-input ('Second implant (optional)'), plus MRNo/Name/Age/Address/Diagnosis/File/Date inputs, Gender segmented, and Save Record button. (3) Typing 1 letter ('k') in all three autocomplete fields with empty web data: value accepted, NO dropdown appears, NO crash — exactly as specified. (4) /signup (3 inputs), /forgot-password (3 inputs), /join-clinic all render without crashes or page errors (join-clinic shows 0 inputs initially by design — password TextInput appears only after a backup file is picked). Only console output is a benign 'shadow* style props are deprecated' warning on web. Backend intentionally not tested (app is 100% offline-first SQLite; FastAPI is an unused starter).

react_native_issues.issue: Web console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — styles.dropdown uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset. Reference: frontend/src/components/AutocompleteField.tsx:150-154. Cosmetic warning on web only; shadows still render.

action_items: OPTIONAL (low priority): Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow in AutocompleteField.tsx dropdown style to silence the react-native-web deprecation warning.
Full E2E (signup -> add procedures/inventory -> autocomplete suggestions -> save patient) must be verified on Android via Expo Go; SQLite web stub intentionally blocks this (by design, not a bug).
critical_code_review_comments: AutocompleteField.tsx is clean: prefix matches ranked before partial matches, exact-match suppression, 150ms blur delay so tap-to-select registers, 44px min-height suggestion rows (touch-target compliant), clear button with hitSlop, testIDs on input/dropdown/each suggestion.

patient-form.tsx correctly merges procedure suggestions from catalogue + past patient records (case-insensitive dedupe) and sources implant suggestions from inventory with stock detail. Suggestion memos handle empty web data gracefully.
Module collision from previous iteration is resolved — only src/theme.tsx exists, no leftover theme.ts.
seed_data_creation: None (web SQLite stub returns empty reads by design).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All web-renderable screens pass with zero page errors.
